styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: West Lake temples, tea villages and silk workshops.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Lake paths, bamboo groves and wetland parks.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Longjing tea, lake fish and cheap noodle shops.

stays.why: Walk to the lake in minutes. Best for first-timers and evening strolls.
Central downtown. Metro, shops and the Grand Canal water bus nearby.
Cheapest beds and fast high-speed trains to Shanghai. Not near the lake.
Quiet wetland parks and newer hotels. Far from West Lake; budget taxi time.

food: Try Dongpo pork, West Lake vinegar fish and Longjing shrimp at a lake-view restaurant.
Cheap eats: noodle and dumpling shops near Wulin Square, about ¥15–30 a bowl.
Drink Longjing green tea in a tea house; prices range widely, so ask first.
Snack streets: Hefang Street for sweets and street food, busiest in the evening.
Vegetarian temples serve simple set meals; check opening hours on the day.
more_time: Swap a lake day for a tea village walk in Meijiawu or Longjing, about 30–40 minutes by taxi.
Add a day trip to Wuzhen or Xitang water towns; check bus and train times on the day.
Take the Grand Canal water bus from Wulin Gate to Gongchen Bridge, about ¥3.

recommend.why: Two nights covers West Lake, a tea village and the old streets at an easy pace.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 10°C, lows near 1°C. Pack a warm coat.
Still cold, around 12°C by day. Few crowds at the lake.
Mild at 17°C; spring blossoms start. Some rain.
Best spring month: 22°C and green tea season begins.
Warm at 26°C; rain picks up. Bring a light rain jacket.
Hot and wet: 29°C with about 18 rain days. Plan indoor breaks.
Hot: highs near 33°C. Go out early morning and evening.
Another hot month, 33°C. Stay near water and shade.
Cooling to 28°C; good for lake walks. Still some rain.
Best month: 23°C, dry and clear. Book hotels early.
Mild at 18°C; autumn colours fade late in the month.
Cold again at 11°C, but the driest month with about 8 rain days.

climate_guide.summary: Humid subtropical: hot, wet summers and cool, fairly dry winters. Spring and autumn are the best seasons.

items.title: Best time: April and October
items.text: Around 22–23°C by day with moderate rain. Ideal for West Lake and tea villages.

items.title: Hot, humid summer (June to August)
items.text: Highs near 29–33°C with many rain days. Go out early and rest indoors at midday.

items.title: Rain peaks in June
items.text: About 18 rain days. Carry a small umbrella and plan indoor sights.

items.title: Cool winters (December to February)
items.text: Highs near 10–12°C, lows near 1–3°C. Rare snow, but damp cold feels sharp.

items.title: Dry, clear autumn
items.text: October and November are the driest and clearest months for photos.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers for spring and autumn, a rain jacket in summer, and a warm coat in winter. Comfortable shoes for lake paths.

transit.best: Metro for most trips; Didi for late nights and the tea villages.

modes.text: 13 lines and about 270 stations; fastest way around town.
Extensive network; K-prefixed routes are air-conditioned, fares about ¥2–3.
Metered taxis start at ¥11; drivers rarely speak English, so show your destination in Chinese. Didi works widely; Uber is not the norm.
Not practical for most visitors; use metro, taxis and bikes instead.
Good around West Lake and old streets; use metro for longer hops.
Public share bikes cost about ¥1–2 per ride; bike lanes are common.
Grand Canal ferry from Wulin Gate to Gongchen Bridge, about ¥3, a few trips daily.
